summary:
• Gemini 4 Hydrogen — Google’s new AI model optimized for fast, cost‑effective code generation and agentic tasks, offering a million‑token context and integration via Gemini API and AI Studio.
• ChatGPT Wallet — OpenAI’s built‑in payment layer lets ChatGPT agents complete purchases with a single user approval, streamlining automated resource provisioning and recurring transactions.
• Manus — an autonomous AI assistant that writes, runs, and drives a browser to execute multi‑step web tasks, letting users automate data collection, form filling, and reporting.
• GitHub Copilot app — a desktop hub from GitHub that consolidates issue browsing, agent execution, and pull‑request management into a single pane, improving workflow efficiency and reducing context switching.
• Agweb — a macOS WebKit‑based browser that runs in the background, providing a CLI‑controlled visible window for coding agents while suspending idle tabs to save CPU.
• datasette‑llm — a plugin for the Datasette platform that lets any OpenAI‑compatible LLM endpoint, including local models, answer natural‑language queries over SQLite data, improving privacy and latency.
